inherits_2020_method.bounds_provenance: Fixed engineering search bounds, not independent material measurements
inherits_2020_method.local_refinement: three predetermined 21x21 logalpha/b grids around the previous optimum
inherits_2020_method.primary_goal: weighted residuals of DC ratio and complex daily and twice-daily ratios
inherits_2020_method.diagnostic_goal: same harmonic ratios without DC, no post-result winner selection
inherits_2020_method.ratio_scales: OLS row-L1 propagated source +/-0.2C deterministic bound; not Gaussian sigma or statistical confidence
inherits_2020_method.null: b=0 with same alpha bounds, observation ratios and weights
inherits_2020_method.rank_check: weighted local Jacobian in log(alpha), b/L; finite difference h=1e-4

geometry_policy: Use fixed sensor depths; refuse any thickness placing probe below ice. +5/+20mm are engineering sensitivity, not source measurement uncertainty.
